snippet.title: Sprig - Official Teaser Trailer | Wishlist on Steam
snippet.description:
Wishlist Sprig on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4690430/Sprig/

Sprig is a gentle 3D exploration game where you play as a curious rabbit discovering real-world animals across peaceful levels.

Explore at your own pace, use tools like a magnifying glass and flashlight, solve light environmental puzzles, and fill your nature journal with the animals you find. Some creatures are easy to spot, while others are hidden behind small puzzles, missing bridge pieces, or paths waiting to be unlocked.

Sprig is designed to be calm and approachable: no enemies, no timers, no scary music, and no pressure to rush. Just exploration, discovery, collections, and a short adventure with a clear beginning and end.

If Sprig looks like your kind of game, wishlisting it on Steam helps a lot and lets you know when it launches.

🌱 Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4690430/Sprig/

Planned features:
Single-player
Animal discovery
Nature journal
Light puzzles
Achievements
Controller support
Demo planned

Thank you for watching and supporting the project!
